sentence_stem: If I had more free time,
correct_completion: I would learn to play the guitar.
full_sentence: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
acceptable_variants: I would start playing the guitar.

options.text: I learned to play the guitar last year.
options.why_wrong: The past simple describes a finished event, but the second conditional talks about an imagined present situation.

options.text: so I have learned to play the guitar.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows the result of a real event. The second conditional describes a situation that is not real.

options.text: I would learn to play the guitar.
I have learned to play guitar since I was ten.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect describes a real past experience, not an imagined situation after 'if'.

grammar_focus: Second conditional for imagined present or future situations
explanation: The second conditional uses a past form after 'if' and 'would' in the main clause to describe an unreal or unlikely situation. Turkish speakers may use a simple tense here, but English needs 'had' with 'would' to show that the situation is imagined.
translation: Daha fazla boş vaktim olsaydı, gitar çalmayı öğrenirdim.
